@@ -765,8 +771,69 @@ class SampleData < Thor
   # rubocop:enable Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity
   # rubocop:enable Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
 
+  desc 'e2e_fixture', 'create the static case the Playwright e2e specs expect (case 219)'
+  long_desc <<-LONGDESC
+  `e2e_fixture`
+
+  Clones the "10s of Queries" case (created by `sample_data`) into case #{RICH_CASE_FIXTURE_ID}, records a
+  snapshot of its rated documents, and points the clone at a `static` search endpoint serving that
+  snapshot, so test/playwright/case_helpers.ts works without a live search engine.
+
+  EXAMPLES:
+
+  $ thor sample_data:e2e_fixture
+  LONGDESC
+  def e2e_fixture
+    load_environment
+
+    source_case = ::Case.find_by case_name: '10s of Queries'
+    if source_case.nil?
+      print_step 'No "10s of Queries" case found; run `thor sample_data:sample_data` first.'
+      return
+    end
+
+    seed_e2e_fixture source_case, source_case.owner
+  end
+
   private
 
+  # Hand-built fixture the Playwright specs assume exists: a clone of the "10s of Queries" case
+  # (same queries and ratings) whose try searches a `static` endpoint backed by a snapshot, so no
+  # external search engine is involved. The id is forced because case_helpers.ts hardcodes it
+  # (override with QUEPID_E2E_CASE_ID).
+  def seed_e2e_fixture source_case, user
+    print_step 'Seeding e2e fixture case................'
+
+    fixture_case = ::Case.find_by id: RICH_CASE_FIXTURE_ID
+    if fixture_case.present?
+      print_step "Case #{RICH_CASE_FIXTURE_ID} already exists (#{fixture_case.case_name}); leaving it alone."
+      return
+    end
+
+    fixture_case = ::Case.new id: RICH_CASE_FIXTURE_ID, case_name: 'E2E Static Fixture (10s of Queries)'
+    fixture_case.clone_case source_case, user, try: source_case.tries.latest, clone_queries: true, clone_ratings: true
+
+    docs_by_query = {}
+    fixture_case.queries.each do |query|
+      docs = query.ratings.order(:id).each_with_index.map do |rating, index|
+        { id: rating.doc_id, position: index + 1, fields: { title: rating.doc_id } }
+      end
+      docs_by_query[query.query_text] = { docs: docs }
+    end
+
+    snapshot = fixture_case.snapshots.create name: 'E2E Static Fixture Results'
+    ::SnapshotManager.new(snapshot).import_queries(docs_by_query)
+
+    static_endpoint = ::SearchEndpoint.create! search_engine: :static, name: 'E2E Static Fixture (10s of Queries) Endpoint', owner: user,
+                                               endpoint_url: "http://localhost:3000/api/cases/#{fixture_case.id}/snapshots/#{snapshot.id}/search",
+                                               api_method: 'GET'
+
+    fixture_case.tries.latest.update! search_endpoint: static_endpoint, field_spec: 'id:id, title:title',
+                                      query_params: 'q=#$query##'
+
+    print_case_info fixture_case
+  end
+
   def seed_judge hash
     ::AiJudge.find_by(name: hash[:name]) || ::AiJudge.create(hash)
   end

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+require 'test_helper'
+require 'thor'
+load Rails.root.join('lib/tasks/sample_data.thor').to_s
+
+class SampleDataE2eFixtureTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
+  let(:user) { users(:random) }
+
+  def build_source_case
+    source = user.cases.create! case_name: '10s of Queries'
+    source.tries.create! try_number: 1, query_params: 'q=#$query##', field_spec: 'id:id, title:title'
+    query = source.queries.create! query_text: 'duck'
+    query.ratings.create! doc_id: 'mallard-001', rating: 3
+    query.ratings.create! doc_id: 'teal-001', rating: 1
+    source
+  end
+
+  test 'e2e_fixture creates case 219 backed by a static snapshot endpoint' do
+    Case.where(id: 219).destroy_all
+    build_source_case
+    assert_nil Case.find_by(id: 219)
+
+    capture_io { SampleData.start([ 'e2e_fixture' ]) }
+
+    fixture = Case.find 219
+    assert_equal 'E2E Static Fixture (10s of Queries)', fixture.case_name
+    assert_equal [ 'duck' ], fixture.queries.map(&:query_text)
+
+    snapshot = fixture.snapshots.first
+    assert_equal %w[mallard-001 teal-001], snapshot.snapshot_queries.first.snapshot_docs.order(:position).map(&:doc_id)
+
+    endpoint = fixture.tries.latest.search_endpoint
+    assert_equal 'static', endpoint.search_engine
+    assert_equal "http://localhost:3000/api/cases/219/snapshots/#{snapshot.id}/search", endpoint.endpoint_url
+  end
+
+  test 'e2e_fixture leaves an existing case 219 alone' do
+    Case.where(id: 219).destroy_all
+    build_source_case
+
+    capture_io { SampleData.start([ 'e2e_fixture' ]) }
+    assert_no_difference 'Case.count' do
+      capture_io { SampleData.start([ 'e2e_fixture' ]) }
+    end
+  end
+end
